headline: Turkey Plans 53 Billion Liras for Industrial Projects in 2027
summary: Turkey's Ministry of Industry and Technology announced plans to allocate 53 billion Turkish liras to industrial zone and estate projects in 2027.
why: Government capital expenditure on industrial infrastructure aims to stimulate regional manufacturing growth and attract foreign direct investment in emerging industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Targeted public infrastructure spending supports domestic industrial output expansion.
